purpose: Validation-only expansion of the METR-LA/PEMS-BAY H12 traffic matrix with a graph-temporal STGCN-style baseline.
research_question: Does the frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon fusion candidate remain competitive with a graph-temporal convolution baseline under the same chronological split and budget?
evidence_boundary: All jobs are validation-only. No held-out test metrics are generated or read, and no candidate setting is selected from this matrix.
claim_boundary: The STGCN implementation is a local canonical-style baseline using the official graph contract; this matrix cannot establish reproduction of an external codebase or a causal AutoCon effect.

required_before_launch: verify speed CSV and adjacency NPZ fingerprints
freeze candidate, STGCN configuration, and common training budget
preserve one source snapshot and immutable launch sidecar

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate and STGCN are compared descriptively; this matrix cannot select a new architecture or hyperparameter.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share loader, chronological split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: STGCN receives only the graph contract and no AutoCon or candidate-only representation flags.

phases.name: candidate_h12_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon prediction-connected fusion candidate.

phases.name: stgcn_h12_validation
phases.purpose: Graph-temporal STGCN-style baseline using the official row-normalized adjacency contract.

stopping_rules: Do not alter the frozen candidate in response to this baseline matrix.
Do not run held-out tests from this expansion.
Report both traffic datasets and all paired seeds, including failures.

preserve one source snapshot and immutable launch sidecar
